title: Five Defining Tactical Decisions in Delhi Capitals’s IPL Story
dek: Strategy leaves fingerprints in the data. Five measurable shifts in how Delhi Capitals play, before and since 2024, show which decisions have defined them.
excerpt: From the toss to the death overs, Delhi Capitals' approach has shifted between 2008–2023 and the seasons since 2024. Five measures, each set against the rest of the league, trace the decisions behind those shifts.

sections.heading: Decisions You Can See in the Data
body: Tactical decisions are made in team rooms, but their effects show up in the numbers: what a side chooses at the toss, how hard it attacks early, how it bowls at the end.
CricField compared Delhi Capitals in 2008–2023 with the seasons since 2024, each time against the rest of the league in the same seasons.

body: After winning the toss, DC chose to bowl first {{ev:ts-toss1}} of the time in 2008–2023 and {{ev:ts-toss2}} since 2024.

sections.heading: Shifts Are Not Always Choices
body: Some of these shifts follow the league rather than lead it, and some follow the players available rather than a plan. The measures are set against the rest of the league to reduce the first problem, not the second.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: Five Fingerprints
body: The five measures show how Delhi Capitals' approach has moved since 2024, relative to the league.
Which of them were deliberate decisions, and which were the squad changing around a plan, is a question for the people in the room.
